observations.body: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Saul enters the wilderness of Engedi while pursuing David.
observations.label: The cave reverses pursuit

observations.body: The wilderness of Engedi turns Saul’s search into David’s hidden opportunity.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 24:1–3 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The pursuer is vulnerable without knowing who is nearby.
payload.title: The cave in Engedi
